claim_a.statement: Conscious information is not transmitted or broadcast from one brain region to another; the locus of consciousness is intrinsic to the PSC, not a relay or global broadcast.

claim_b.statement: The locus of conscious processing is a large-scale prefrontal-parietal (and cingulate/temporal) cortical network, not posterior sensory cortices alone.
